usage: llm-modelbench freeze [-h] [--repo-root REPO_ROOT]
                             [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                             [--rankings-dir RANKINGS_DIR] --out OUT
                             [--label LABEL] [--no-rankings-copy] [--verify]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo-root REPO_ROOT
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR
  --rankings-dir RANKINGS_DIR
  --out OUT
  --label LABEL
  --no-rankings-copy
  --verify              verify an existing snapshot at --out without
                        rebuilding it
